From Saturday 26 September, Bristol Dockyards turns into Shaun's science lab. Hunt down bonkers challenges across the site, help power up the SS Great Britain and earn your place in the flock of official Ma-ad Scientists.

## Bristol subscriber-email draft — weekday send

**Subject:** A woolly science mission is landing in Bristol

**Preheader:** Shaun-inspired challenges at Bristol Dockyards from Saturday 26 September.

A new family mission lands at Bristol Dockyards this Saturday.

Ma-ad Science Mayhem sends children around the site to tackle a string of science challenges and help power up the SS Great Britain. The trail mixes indoor and outdoor activities, so it has a little more weather protection than the average weekend expedition.

It runs from 26 September to 1 November and is included with admission. Online general admission is £14.50 for a child and £22 for an adult; the full-price ticket includes named return visits for a year. There is also an Afternoon Saver from 2.30pm for £13 online.

Children under 14 need an adult. The organiser has not published a numerical recommended age, so have a quick look at the activity description before booking for very young children.

See the organiser details:  
https://www.bristoldockyards.org/whats-on/ma-ad-science-mayhem

Find more Bristol ideas:  
https://donext.co.uk/bristol/
